FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_SAF_SiliconSmeltingElectrode
(*
========================================================================================================================
  PROJECT      : 42 MVA THREE-PHASE SUBMERGED ARC FURNACE (SAF) - METALLURGICAL GRADE SILICON SMELTING
  SUBSYSTEM    : SÖDERBERG CONTINUOUS SELF-BAKING ELECTRODE SINKING & DYNAMIC ARC RESISTANCE REGULATION
  DESIGNATION  : SIL-2 / CLASS I DIV 2 HIGH-CURRENT PYROMETALLURGICAL CYBER-PHYSICAL AUTOMATION CONTROLLER
  SPECIFICATION: IEC 61131-3 3RD EDITION / ISA-18.2 ALARM MANAGEMENT / IEEE C37.90 FURNACE PROTECTION
  AUTHOR       : PRINCIPAL AUTOMATION FELLOW & CYBER-PHYSICAL SYSTEMS CHAIR (LUMINA SWARM)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  THEORETICAL AND CYBER-PHYSICAL FORMULATION:
    1. CARBOTHERMIC SILICON REDUCTION THERMODYNAMICS & ELECTRODE CAVITY PHYSICS:
       In submerged arc production of chemical/metallurgical grade silicon (Si >= 98.5% wt), high-purity quartzite
       (SiO2) reacts with carbonaceous reductants (low-ash coal, charcoal, woodchips) at temperatures exceeding 1850-2000 deg C:
           SiO2 + 2 C  <==>  Si(l) + 2 CO(g)                 (Net overall carbothermic reduction)
           SiO2 + 3 C  <==>  SiC(s) + 2 CO(g)                (Low-temperature zone intermediate, T ~ 1500-1700 deg C)
           2 SiC + SiO2 <==> 3 Si(l) + SiO(g)                (High-temperature cavity reaction, T > 1850 deg C)
           SiO + C     <==>  SiC + CO                        (Gas condensation capture in burden upper shaft)
       The electrical arc burns within a hollow gas cavity beneath the Söderberg electrode tip, surrounded by a semi-fused
       silicon carbide (SiC) crater wall. Electric current flows via a hybrid path: concentrated plasma discharge (arc)
       and ohmic conduction through the partially molten charge crust and slag bath.
       
    2. REAL-TIME ARC RESISTANCE ESTIMATION & IMPEDANCE DECOUPLING:
       Because submerged electric arcs exhibit strong non-linear V-I hysteresis and asymmetric harmonic distortion,
       calculating pure arc resistance from instantaneous voltage and current requires phase-decoupled power decomposition:
           S_phase = V_rms * I_rms                           [MVA]
           P_active = (1/T) * integral(v(t) * i(t) dt)       [MW]
           Q_reactive = sqrt(S_phase^2 - P_active^2)          [MVAR]
           R_arc_est = (P_active * 10^3) / (I_rms^2)          [mOhm]
           X_lead_est = (Q_reactive * 10^3) / (I_rms^2)       [mOhm]
       Where R_arc_est represents the equivalent star-point phase resistance and X_lead_est reflects bus-tube, flexible
       water-cooled cable, and electrode column operational reactance.

    3. SÖDERBERG CONTINUOUS SELF-BAKING ELECTRODE COLUMN THERMODYNAMICS & SLIPPING:
       The continuous Söderberg electrode consists of a cylindrical carbon steel casing (1.2 to 1.6 m diameter) with
       internal trapezoidal ribs, into which unbaked green carbonaceous paste cylinders are periodically charged.
       Baking occurs in situ via two distinct heat sources:
         a) Resistive Joule dissipation (I^2 * R_column) generated by secondary currents (60 - 110 kA RMS).
         b) Conductive and radiative heat transfer from the 2000 deg C reaction crucible through the contact shoes.
       The critical baking isothermal zone (450 to 550 deg C) where coal tar pitch volatiles pyrolyze and transform into
       a solid semi-coke matrix MUST remain positioned strictly below the contact clamps.
       Electrode consumption (tip erosion by sublimation, carbon oxidation, and silicon alloy dissolution) consumes carbon
       at a rate of approximately 15 - 28 mm/MWh of active electrical energy.
       Dynamic slipping must fulfill the Specific Cumulative Baking Integral (SCBI):
           E_accumulated = integral(P_active * dt) >= E_slip_target [MWh]
       Where E_slip_target = L_slip * A_casing * rho_paste * q_bake_spec.
       Premature slipping causes "soft breaks" (green paste rupture into the molten metal bath causing violent blowouts),
       while delayed slipping causes "hard breaks" or excessive contact clamp overheating.

    4. TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) ROGOWSKI CURRENT VOTING ARCHITECTURE:
       Secondary phase currents exceeding 100 kA are measured by three hermetically sealed, non-saturating Rogowski coils
       mounted symmetrically on the secondary water-cooled delta-closure flex busbars:
           I_ch1, I_ch2, I_ch3
       Voting logic isolates anomalous channel drift (|I_i - I_j| > delta_TMR_limit = 4.5 kA), sensor open-circuit,
       or integrator saturation, dynamically degrading across: 2oo3 -> 2oo2 -> 1oo1 -> Degraded Safe Manual Hold.

    5. STATE-SPACE DISCRETE MODEL PREDICTIVE POSITION CONTROL (MPC):
       Electrode vertical positioning is driven by twin high-pressure hydraulic hoisting cylinders actuated by
       proportional servo valves with linear displacement transducers (LVDTs).
       State vector x(k) in R^4:
           x_1(k) = R_arc(k) - R_setpoint                   (Arc resistance error [mOhm])
           x_2(k) = d(R_arc)/dt                             (Rate of change of arc resistance [mOhm/s])
           x_3(k) = I_voted(k) - I_nominal                  (Current deviation from furnace rating [kA])
           x_4(k) = z_pos(k) - z_hearth_ref                 (Electrode tip vertical position [mm])
       Control input u(k) in R:
           u(k) = v_hoist_cmd                               (Electrode hoisting velocity [mm/s], -25.0 to +35.0 mm/s)
       State Transition Matrix A (dt = 0.1 s):
           A = | 0.9650   0.0920  -0.0012   0.0000 |
               | -0.2450  0.8800  -0.0085   0.0000 |
               | -18.500  -1.250   0.9400   0.0000 |
               |  0.0000  0.0000   0.0000   1.0000 |
       Input Matrix B:
           B = [ 0.00385,  0.03850,  -0.7850,  0.1000 ]^T
       Sensitivity coefficient: dR/dz = +0.00385 mOhm/mm (raising electrode lengthens arc, increasing resistance).
========================================================================================================================
*)

VAR_INPUT
    (* --- Master Permissives and Operational Selectors --- *)
    bMasterEnable                   : BOOL;     (* Master automation enable permissive [TRUE = Active, FALSE = Inhibited] *)
    bSafetyEStopOk                  : BOOL;     (* Hardwired SIL-3 emergency stop circuit healthy [TRUE = Healthy, FALSE = Tripped] *)
    bAutoRegulationSelect           : BOOL;     (* Automatic arc resistance closed-loop regulation selector [TRUE = Auto, FALSE = Manual] *)
    bSoderbergSlipPermissive         : BOOL;     (* Furnace process supervisory permissive for automated casing slipping *)
    bTapHoleActive                  : BOOL;     (* Taphole open flag indicating liquid bath drawdown transient *)

    (* --- Primary High-Current Electrical Telemetry & Transducers --- *)
    rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1        : REAL;     (* Redundant Rogowski coil secondary current Channel 1 [kA] (0.0 .. 150.0) *)
    rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2        : REAL;     (* Redundant Rogowski coil secondary current Channel 2 [kA] (0.0 .. 150.0) *)
    rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3        : REAL;     (* Redundant Rogowski coil secondary current Channel 3 [kA] (0.0 .. 150.0) *)
    rSecondaryVoltage_V             : REAL;     (* Secondary true RMS electrode-to-furnace-hearth potential [V] (30.0 .. 380.0) *)
    rArcResistanceSP_mOhm           : REAL;     (* Supervisory arc resistance operating setpoint [mOhm] (0.60 .. 3.20) *)
    rElectrodePosition_mm           : REAL;     (* Hoisting cylinder dual-LVDT calibrated vertical stroke position [mm] (0.0 .. 3200.0) *)
    rActivePower_MW                 : REAL;     (* Secondary active electric power measurement [MW] (0.0 .. 45.0) *)
    rReactivePower_MVAR             : REAL;     (* Secondary reactive power measurement [MVAR] (0.0 .. 35.0) *)

    (* --- Thermomechanical & Hydraulic Auxiliary Transducers --- *)
    rClampTemperature_DegC          : REAL;     (* Söderberg bronze contact shoe cooling water discharge temp [deg C] (10.0 .. 120.0) *)
    rFurnaceFreeboardPressure_Pa    : REAL;     (* Sealed furnace hood gas differential static pressure [Pa] (-250.0 .. +500.0) *)
    rHydraulicSupplyPressure_bar    : REAL;     (* Hydraulic power unit main supply manifold pressure [bar] (0.0 .. 250.0) *)
    bChargeFeedActive               : BOOL;     (* Raw quartzite/woodchip batch charging chute discharge active *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    (* --- Primary Hydraulic Actuation Commands --- *)
    bSystemReady                    : BOOL;     (* Overall electrode automation block operational readiness indicator *)
    bDegradedModeActive             : BOOL;     (* Operating under sensor anomaly or degraded fallback control *)
    rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct         : REAL;     (* Proportional hydraulic servo valve spool command [%] (-100.0 .. +100.0) *)
    rHoistVelocityCmd_mms           : REAL;     (* Commanded electrode column vertical displacement velocity [mm/s] *)
    
    (* --- Söderberg Friction Slipping Mechanism Interlocks --- *)
    bSlipUpperClampGrip             : BOOL;     (* Hydraulic slipping ring upper friction clamp pressurize command *)
    bSlipLowerClampGrip             : BOOL;     (* Hydraulic holding ring lower friction clamp pressurize command *)
    bSlipCycleActive                : BOOL;     (* Söderberg automatic 20mm slipping stroke cycle in execution *)
    
    (* --- Process Diagnostics & Validated Metallurgical Parameters --- *)
    rEstimatedArcResistance_mOhm    : REAL;     (* Real-time validated dynamic arc resistance [mOhm] *)
    rEstimatedArcReactance_mOhm     : REAL;     (* Real-time secondary operating circuit reactance [mOhm] *)
    rAccumulatedBakingEnergy_MWh    : REAL;     (* Söderberg paste thermal baking energy integral since last slip [MWh] *)
    rDailyElectrodeConsumption_mm   : REAL;     (* Integrated cumulative electrode tip consumption estimate [mm] *)
    
    (* --- Standardized Status and Diagnostic Words --- *)
    wAlarmWord                      : WORD;     (* ISA-18.2 packed alarm classification word *)
    wSystemStatusWord               : WORD;     (* Discrete automation state machine status indicator word *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* --- Finite State Machine Core Registers --- *)
    iState                          : INT := 0; (* Active operational state index *)
    iPreviousState                  : INT := 0; (* Historical state transition tracker *)
    udiCycleCounter                 : UDINT := 0;(* Continuous cycle execution counter *)

    (* --- Triple Modular Redundancy (2oo3 TMR) Rogowski Current Registers --- *)
    bCh1_Valid                      : BOOL := TRUE;
    bCh2_Valid                      : BOOL := TRUE;
    bCh3_Valid                      : BOOL := TRUE;
    iHealthySensorCount             : INT := 3;
    rDelta12                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta23                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rDelta31                        : REAL := 0.0;
    rTmrToleranceLimit_kA           : REAL := 4.5;  (* Maximum allowable inter-channel Rogowski divergence [kA] *)
    rVotedCurrent_kA                : REAL := 0.0;  (* Validated 2oo3 consensus secondary electrode current [kA] *)

    (* --- Digital Butterworth Low-Pass Signal Conditioners --- *)
    rCurrent_Filt_kA                : REAL := 0.0;
    rVoltage_Filt_V                 : REAL := 0.0;
    rPower_Filt_MW                  : REAL := 0.0;
    rArcResRaw_mOhm                 : REAL := 1.25;
    rArcResFilt_mOhm                : REAL := 1.25;
    rArcResPrev_mOhm                : REAL := 1.25;
    rArcResRate_mOhms               : REAL := 0.0;

    (* --- State-Space Discrete Model Predictive Control (MPC) Matrices (dt = 0.1 s) --- *)
    (* State Vector x:
         x[0] = delta_R (mOhm deviation from setpoint)
         x[1] = d(delta_R)/dt (mOhm/s rate of change)
         x[2] = delta_I (current deviation from nominal 78.0 kA)
         x[3] = relative position z_pos [mm]
    *)
    rState_x1_ResErr                : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x2_ResDeriv              : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x3_CurrDev               : REAL := 0.0;
    rState_x4_RelPosition           : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Linearized Plant Coefficients *)
    rA11 : REAL := 0.9650;  rA12 : REAL := 0.0920;  rB1 : REAL := 0.00385; (* Sensitivity dR/dz [mOhm/mm] *)
    rA21 : REAL := -0.2450; rA22 : REAL := 0.8800;  rB2 : REAL := 0.03850;
    rA31 : REAL := -18.500; rA32 : REAL := -1.250;  rB3 : REAL := -0.7850; (* Current response to hoist movement *)

    (* Optimal MPC Gains & Receding Horizon Penalties *)
    rWeight_Q_ResErr                : REAL := 820.0;(* Penalty on arc resistance error *)
    rWeight_Q_CurrDev               : REAL := 1.85; (* Penalty on electrode overcurrent *)
    rWeight_R_Effort                : REAL := 0.42; (* Penalty on hydraulic spool displacement *)
    rPredictedResErr_Horizon        : REAL := 0.0;
    rUnconstrainedVelocityCmd       : REAL := 0.0;

    (* --- Söderberg Dynamic Baking and Slipping Logic Accumulators --- *)
    rEnergyTargetPerSlip_MWh        : REAL := 2.85; (* Required thermal energy per 20 mm slip step [MWh] *)
    rSlipStrokeIncrement_mm         : REAL := 20.0; (* Standard single slip mechanical displacement [mm] *)
    rPositionAtSlipStart_mm         : REAL := 0.0;
    rTotalSlippedLength_mm          : REAL := 0.0;
    iSlipStepIndex                  : INT := 0;

    (* --- Dynamic Hydraulic Deadbands and Velocity Envelopes --- *)
    rDeadbandResistance_mOhm        : REAL := 0.035;(* Anti-hunting deadband (+/- 0.035 mOhm) *)
    rMaxRaiseVelocity_mms           : REAL := 32.0; (* Maximum safe upward hoisting velocity [mm/s] *)
    rMaxLowerVelocity_mms           : REAL := -22.0;(* Maximum safe downward sinking velocity [mm/s] *)
    rEmergencyRetractVelocity_mms   : REAL := 35.0; (* High-speed retract velocity during short-circuit [mm/s] *)

    (* --- System Timers & Watchdogs --- *)
    tonStartupDelay                 : TON;
    tonShortCircuitPersistence      : TON;
    tonArcExtinctionPersistence     : TON;
    tonSlipSequenceTimer            : TON;
    tonHydraulicPressureDebounce    : TON;
    tonThermalWarningDebounce       : TON;

    (* --- Empirical Tip Wear Model --- *)
    rNominalSpecificBurnRate_mmMWh  : REAL := 22.5; (* Metallurgical silicon specific consumption [mm/MWh] *)
    rIncrementalEnergy_MWh          : REAL := 0.0;
END_VAR

(*
========================================================================================================================
  CYCLIC REAL-TIME EXECUTION TASK (PERIOD dt = 100 ms)
========================================================================================================================
*)

udiCycleCounter := udiCycleCounter + 1;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 1: HARDWIRED SAFETY INTERLOCKS & DETERMINISTIC EMERGENCY TRIPS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF NOT bSafetyEStopOk THEN
    (* Immediate hydraulic locking and fail-safe neutral spool positioning *)
    bSystemReady                := FALSE;
    bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
    rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct     := 0.0;
    rHoistVelocityCmd_mms       := 0.0;
    bSlipCycleActive            := FALSE;
    bSlipUpperClampGrip         := TRUE;  (* Fail-safe mechanical clamp engagement *)
    bSlipLowerClampGrip         := TRUE;  (* Holding clamp mechanically pressurized *)
    
    wAlarmWord.0                := TRUE;  (* Critical E-Stop Circuit Open Trip *)
    wSystemStatusWord           := 16#F000;
    iState                      := 99;    (* Force Transition to Safe E-Stop State *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

wAlarmWord.0 := FALSE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 2: TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3 TMR) ROGOWSKI CURRENT SENSOR VOTING
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Verify physical range plausibility for high-current Rogowski sensors [0.5 kA to 140.0 kA] *)
bCh1_Valid := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1 >= 0.5) AND (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1 <= 140.0);
bCh2_Valid := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2 >= 0.5) AND (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2 <= 140.0);
bCh3_Valid := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3 >= 0.5) AND (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3 <= 140.0);

rDelta12 := ABS(rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1 - rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2);
rDelta23 := ABS(rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2 - rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3);
rDelta31 := ABS(rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3 - rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1);

IF bCh1_Valid AND bCh2_Valid AND bCh3_Valid THEN
    IF (rDelta12 <= rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) AND (rDelta23 <= rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) AND (rDelta31 <= rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) THEN
        (* All three current channels congruent - Full 2oo3 consensus mean *)
        rVotedCurrent_kA    := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3) / 3.0;
        iHealthySensorCount := 3;
        wAlarmWord.2        := FALSE; (* TMR Divergence Alarm Cleared *)
    ELSIF (rDelta12 <= rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) AND (rDelta23 > rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) AND (rDelta31 > rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) THEN
        (* Channel 3 drifting or faulted: Isolate Ch3, resolve Ch1 & Ch2 *)
        rVotedCurrent_kA    := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2) / 2.0;
        bCh3_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthySensorCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2        := TRUE;  (* Sensor Ch3 Divergence Warning *)
    ELSIF (rDelta23 <= rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) AND (rDelta12 > rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) AND (rDelta31 > rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) THEN
        (* Channel 1 drifting or faulted: Isolate Ch1, resolve Ch2 & Ch3 *)
        rVotedCurrent_kA    := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3) / 2.0;
        bCh1_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthySensorCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2        := TRUE;  (* Sensor Ch1 Divergence Warning *)
    ELSIF (rDelta31 <= rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) AND (rDelta12 > rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) AND (rDelta23 > rTmrToleranceLimit_kA) THEN
        (* Channel 2 drifting or faulted: Isolate Ch2, resolve Ch1 & Ch3 *)
        rVotedCurrent_kA    := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3) / 2.0;
        bCh2_Valid          := FALSE;
        iHealthySensorCount := 2;
        wAlarmWord.2        := TRUE;  (* Sensor Ch2 Divergence Warning *)
    ELSE
        (* Total TMR Discordance across all three channels: Degraded Median Voting *)
        rVotedCurrent_kA    := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3) / 3.0;
        iHealthySensorCount := 1;
        wAlarmWord.2        := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord.3        := TRUE;  (* Critical Rogowski Bus Incoherence *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bCh1_Valid AND bCh2_Valid THEN
    rVotedCurrent_kA    := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2) / 2.0;
    iHealthySensorCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2        := TRUE;
ELSIF bCh2_Valid AND bCh3_Valid THEN
    rVotedCurrent_kA    := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3) / 2.0;
    iHealthySensorCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2        := TRUE;
ELSIF bCh1_Valid AND bCh3_Valid THEN
    rVotedCurrent_kA    := (rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1 + rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3) / 2.0;
    iHealthySensorCount := 2;
    wAlarmWord.2        := TRUE;
ELSIF bCh1_Valid THEN
    rVotedCurrent_kA    := rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch1;
    iHealthySensorCount := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3        := TRUE;
ELSIF bCh2_Valid THEN
    rVotedCurrent_kA    := rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch2;
    iHealthySensorCount := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3        := TRUE;
ELSIF bCh3_Valid THEN
    rVotedCurrent_kA    := rElectrodeCurrent_kA_Ch3;
    iHealthySensorCount := 1;
    wAlarmWord.3        := TRUE;
ELSE
    (* Total Telemetry Loss - Set Failsafe Baseline Current and Trigger Alarm *)
    rVotedCurrent_kA    := 45.0;
    iHealthySensorCount := 0;
    wAlarmWord.3        := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 3: SIGNAL FILTERING, IMPEDANCE DECOUPLING & METALLURGICAL CALCULATIONS
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* First-order low-pass digital filtering (tau = 0.35 s, dt = 0.1 s) *)
rCurrent_Filt_kA := (rCurrent_Filt_kA * 0.7788) + (rVotedCurrent_kA * 0.2212);
rVoltage_Filt_V  := (rVoltage_Filt_V  * 0.7788) + (rSecondaryVoltage_V * 0.2212);
rPower_Filt_MW   := (rPower_Filt_MW   * 0.8500) + (rActivePower_MW * 0.1500);

(* Arc Resistance Calculation via Active Power and True RMS Current: R = P / I^2 *)
IF rCurrent_Filt_kA > 2.0 THEN
    (* Arc resistance in milliohms: (P[MW] * 1000) / (I[kA]^2) *)
    rArcResRaw_mOhm := (rPower_Filt_MW * 1000.0) / (rCurrent_Filt_kA * rCurrent_Filt_kA);
    (* Operating reactance in milliohms: (Q[MVAR] * 1000) / (I[kA]^2) *)
    rEstimatedArcReactance_mOhm := (rReactivePower_MVAR * 1000.0) / (rCurrent_Filt_kA * rCurrent_Filt_kA);
ELSE
    rArcResRaw_mOhm := 10.0; (* Open circuit or idle default *)
    rEstimatedArcReactance_mOhm := 1.80;
END_IF;

(* Bound and filter estimated arc resistance *)
IF rArcResRaw_mOhm > 8.0 THEN
    rArcResRaw_mOhm := 8.0;
ELSIF rArcResRaw_mOhm < 0.10 THEN
    rArcResRaw_mOhm := 0.10;
END_IF;

rArcResFilt_mOhm := (rArcResFilt_mOhm * 0.70) + (rArcResRaw_mOhm * 0.30);
rEstimatedArcResistance_mOhm := rArcResFilt_mOhm;

(* Real-time numerical derivative of arc resistance [mOhm/s] *)
rArcResRate_mOhms := (rArcResFilt_mOhm - rArcResPrev_mOhm) / 0.10;
rArcResPrev_mOhm  := rArcResFilt_mOhm;

(* Söderberg Cumulative Baking Energy Integral: E [MWh] += P [MW] * (dt [s] / 3600.0) *)
rIncrementalEnergy_MWh := rPower_Filt_MW * (0.10 / 3600.0);
rAccumulatedBakingEnergy_MWh := rAccumulatedBakingEnergy_MWh + rIncrementalEnergy_MWh;

(* Real-Time Empirical Tip Wear Integration [mm] *)
rDailyElectrodeConsumption_mm := rDailyElectrodeConsumption_mm + (rIncrementalEnergy_MWh * rNominalSpecificBurnRate_mmMWh);

(* State-Space Error Variables *)
rState_x1_ResErr      := rEstimatedArcResistance_mOhm - rArcResistanceSP_mOhm;
rState_x2_ResDeriv    := rArcResRate_mOhms;
rState_x3_CurrDev     := rCurrent_Filt_kA - 78.0; (* 78 kA is nominal rated operating current *)
rState_x4_RelPosition := rElectrodePosition_mm;

(* Model Predictive Control Horizon Error Projection (1-Step Ahead) *)
rPredictedResErr_Horizon := (rA11 * rState_x1_ResErr) + (rA12 * rState_x2_ResDeriv);

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 4: MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (ISA-88 MODULAR STATES)
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
CASE iState OF

    0: (* STATE_INIT_DIAGNOSTICS: Cold Start Transducer & Auxiliary Interlock Verification *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
        rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rHoistVelocityCmd_mms       := 0.0;
        bSlipCycleActive            := FALSE;
        bSlipUpperClampGrip         := TRUE;
        bSlipLowerClampGrip         := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0001;

        tonStartupDelay(IN := bMasterEnable, PT := T#4S);
        IF tonStartupDelay.Q THEN
            tonStartupDelay(IN := FALSE);
            IF (rHydraulicSupplyPressure_bar >= 140.0) AND (iHealthySensorCount >= 2) THEN
                iState := 10; (* Advance to Hydraulic Standby Hold *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord.4 := TRUE; (* Hydraulic Pressure or Sensor Unavailability Fault *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE_STANDBY_HYDRAULIC_HOLD: Static Column Holding Under Counterbalance Pressure *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := (iHealthySensorCount < 3);
        rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rHoistVelocityCmd_mms       := 0.0;
        bSlipCycleActive            := FALSE;
        bSlipUpperClampGrip         := TRUE;
        bSlipLowerClampGrip         := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0010;

        IF bMasterEnable AND bAutoRegulationSelect THEN
            IF rCurrent_Filt_kA > 15.0 THEN
                iState := 30; (* Arc Already Established - Engage Closed-Loop Regulation *)
            ELSE
                iState := 20; (* Cold Arc Ignition Sinking Required *)
            END_IF;
        ELSIF NOT bMasterEnable THEN
            iState := 0;
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE_ARC_IGNITION_SINKING: Controlled Sinking to Touch Burden & Strike Arc *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0020;
        bSlipCycleActive            := FALSE;
        bSlipUpperClampGrip         := TRUE;
        bSlipLowerClampGrip         := TRUE;

        (* Controlled descent at -8.0 mm/s until electrical contact closes *)
        rHoistVelocityCmd_mms       := -8.0;
        rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct     := -28.0;

        (* Strike detection: current surges above 25.0 kA *)
        IF rCurrent_Filt_kA >= 25.0 THEN
            (* Arc struck: Hold descent and transition immediately to closed loop *)
            rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := 0.0;
            rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := 0.0;
            iState                  := 30;
        ELSIF rElectrodePosition_mm <= 150.0 THEN
            (* Hearth proximity limit reached without strike - abort sinking *)
            rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := 0.0;
            rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := 0.0;
            wAlarmWord.7            := TRUE; (* Sinking Bottom Limit Reached *)
            iState                  := 10;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE_NORMAL_MPC_RESISTANCE_REGULATION: Dynamic Model Predictive Arc Optimization *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := (iHealthySensorCount < 3);
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0030;
        bSlipCycleActive            := FALSE;
        bSlipUpperClampGrip         := TRUE;
        bSlipLowerClampGrip         := TRUE;

        (* Check for severe overcurrent or short-circuit condition (cave-in / slag boil) *)
        IF (rCurrent_Filt_kA > 105.0) OR (rEstimatedArcResistance_mOhm < 0.45) THEN
            iState := 40; (* Trigger High-Speed Retract *)
        ELSIF (rAccumulatedBakingEnergy_MWh >= rEnergyTargetPerSlip_MWh) AND bSoderbergSlipPermissive AND NOT bTapHoleActive THEN
            iState := 50; (* Initiate Söderberg Controlled Casing Slip *)
        ELSIF iHealthySensorCount <= 1 THEN
            iState := 60; (* Fallback to Degraded Manual Mode *)
        ELSE
            (* Closed-Loop Model Predictive Control Algorithm *)
            IF ABS(rState_x1_ResErr) > rDeadbandResistance_mOhm THEN
                (* Unconstrained optimal control velocity synthesis:
                   If R_arc < R_setpoint (State_x1 < 0) -> Hoist UP (v > 0)
                   If R_arc > R_setpoint (State_x1 > 0) -> Lower DOWN (v < 0)
                *)
                rUnconstrainedVelocityCmd := -(rPredictedResErr_Horizon * (rWeight_Q_ResErr / (rWeight_R_Effort + 1.0)))
                                             - (rState_x3_CurrDev * 0.12);

                (* Apply dynamic physical velocity ceilings *)
                IF rUnconstrainedVelocityCmd > rMaxRaiseVelocity_mms THEN
                    rHoistVelocityCmd_mms := rMaxRaiseVelocity_mms;
                ELSIF rUnconstrainedVelocityCmd < rMaxLowerVelocity_mms THEN
                    rHoistVelocityCmd_mms := rMaxLowerVelocity_mms;
                ELSE
                    rHoistVelocityCmd_mms := rUnconstrainedVelocityCmd;
                END_IF;

                (* Non-linear proportional valve flow-to-spool mapping *)
                IF rHoistVelocityCmd_mms >= 0.0 THEN
                    rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := (rHoistVelocityCmd_mms / rMaxRaiseVelocity_mms) * 88.0 + 8.0; (* Overcome deadzone *)
                ELSE
                    rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := (rHoistVelocityCmd_mms / ABS(rMaxLowerVelocity_mms)) * 82.0 - 8.0;
                END_IF;
            ELSE
                (* Within tight deadband (+/- 0.035 mOhm) - Zero velocity hydraulic lock *)
                rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := 0.0;
                rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := 0.0;
            END_IF;

            (* Compensation for active burden batch charging: damp sinking velocity *)
            IF bChargeFeedActive AND (rHoistVelocityCmd_mms < 0.0) THEN
                rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := rHoistVelocityCmd_mms * 0.50;
                rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct * 0.50;
            END_IF;

            (* Boundary protection against mechanical travel limits *)
            IF (rElectrodePosition_mm >= 3050.0) AND (rHoistVelocityCmd_mms > 0.0) THEN
                rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := 0.0;
                rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := 0.0;
                wAlarmWord.8            := TRUE; (* Hoist Upper Stroke Limit *)
            ELSIF (rElectrodePosition_mm <= 180.0) AND (rHoistVelocityCmd_mms < 0.0) THEN
                rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := 0.0;
                rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := 0.0;
                wAlarmWord.9            := TRUE; (* Hoist Lower Stroke Limit *)
            ELSE
                wAlarmWord.8 := FALSE;
                wAlarmWord.9 := FALSE;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE_FAST_RETRACT_SHORT_CIRCUIT: High-Speed Hoisting to Clear Cave-In Short Circuit *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0040;
        wAlarmWord.5                := TRUE; (* Bath Short-Circuit / Overcurrent Alarm *)
        bSlipCycleActive            := FALSE;

        (* Command maximum emergency raising velocity to pull electrode tip out of slag boil *)
        rHoistVelocityCmd_mms       := rEmergencyRetractVelocity_mms;
        rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct     := 100.0;

        (* Short circuit resolved once current drops below 85.0 kA and resistance recovers above 0.70 mOhm *)
        IF (rCurrent_Filt_kA <= 85.0) AND (rEstimatedArcResistance_mOhm >= 0.70) THEN
            wAlarmWord.5            := FALSE;
            rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := 0.0;
            rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := 0.0;
            iState                  := 30; (* Return to closed-loop MPC *)
        ELSIF rElectrodePosition_mm >= 3100.0 THEN
            (* Upper safety overrun limit *)
            rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := 0.0;
            rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := 0.0;
            iState                  := 10;
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE_SODERBERG_CONTROLLED_SLIP: Synchronized Hydraulic Ring Casing Slipping Cycle *)
        bSystemReady                := TRUE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
        bSlipCycleActive            := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0050;
        wAlarmWord.6                := TRUE; (* Slipping Sequence In Progress Notice *)

        (* Freeze hoisting cylinder movement during slip cycle *)
        rHoistVelocityCmd_mms       := 0.0;
        rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct     := 0.0;

        CASE iSlipStepIndex OF
            0: (* Step 0: Ensure Upper Friction Ring is Fully Pressurized *)
                bSlipUpperClampGrip := TRUE;
                bSlipLowerClampGrip := TRUE;
                tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
                IF tonSlipSequenceTimer.Q THEN
                    tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := FALSE);
                    rPositionAtSlipStart_mm := rElectrodePosition_mm;
                    iSlipStepIndex := 10;
                END_IF;

            10: (* Step 10: Release Lower Holding Clamp *)
                bSlipUpperClampGrip := TRUE;
                bSlipLowerClampGrip := FALSE; (* De-pressurize holding shoe *)
                tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
                IF tonSlipSequenceTimer.Q THEN
                    tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := FALSE);
                    iSlipStepIndex := 20;
                END_IF;

            20: (* Step 20: Stroke Slipping Ring Downward Exactly 20 mm *)
                bSlipUpperClampGrip := TRUE;
                bSlipLowerClampGrip := FALSE;
                tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);
                IF tonSlipSequenceTimer.Q THEN
                    tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := FALSE);
                    iSlipStepIndex := 30;
                END_IF;

            30: (* Step 30: Re-pressurize Lower Holding Clamp to Lock Casing *)
                bSlipUpperClampGrip := TRUE;
                bSlipLowerClampGrip := TRUE;
                tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
                IF tonSlipSequenceTimer.Q THEN
                    tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := FALSE);
                    iSlipStepIndex := 40;
                END_IF;

            40: (* Step 40: Release Upper Clamp and Retract Slipping Ring Upward to Home *)
                bSlipUpperClampGrip := FALSE;
                bSlipLowerClampGrip := TRUE;
                tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
                IF tonSlipSequenceTimer.Q THEN
                    tonSlipSequenceTimer(IN := FALSE);
                    bSlipUpperClampGrip := TRUE;
                    iSlipStepIndex := 50;
                END_IF;

            50: (* Step 50: Verify Mechanical Clamp Interlocks and Reset Baking Accumulator *)
                bSlipUpperClampGrip := TRUE;
                bSlipLowerClampGrip := TRUE;
                rTotalSlippedLength_mm := rTotalSlippedLength_mm + rSlipStrokeIncrement_mm;
                rAccumulatedBakingEnergy_MWh := 0.0; (* Reset thermal baking accumulator *)
                wAlarmWord.6 := FALSE;
                bSlipCycleActive := FALSE;
                iSlipStepIndex := 0;
                iState := 30; (* Return to Normal Regulation *)
        END_CASE;

    60: (* STATE_DEGRADED_MANUAL_REGULATION: Current Sensor Loss / Degraded Fallback Mode *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#0060;
        wAlarmWord.10               := TRUE; (* Degraded Operation Alert *)
        bSlipCycleActive            := FALSE;

        (* Failsafe slow regulation based purely on Secondary Voltage and active power *)
        IF rSecondaryVoltage_V < 110.0 THEN
            (* Tip is likely too deep - raise slowly at +4.0 mm/s *)
            rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := 4.0;
            rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := 18.0;
        ELSIF rSecondaryVoltage_V > 240.0 THEN
            (* Voltage high, arc long - sink slowly at -3.0 mm/s *)
            rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := -3.0;
            rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := -14.0;
        ELSE
            rHoistVelocityCmd_mms   := 0.0;
            rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct := 0.0;
        END_IF;

        (* Recover to full automatic regulation if sensor redundancy is restored *)
        IF (iHealthySensorCount >= 2) AND bAutoRegulationSelect THEN
            wAlarmWord.10 := FALSE;
            iState := 30;
        END_IF;

    99: (* STATE_EMERGENCY_ESTOP_TRIP: Complete Shutoff and Safe Mechanical Locking *)
        bSystemReady                := FALSE;
        bDegradedModeActive         := FALSE;
        rHoistValveSpoolCmd_Pct     := 0.0;
        rHoistVelocityCmd_mms       := 0.0;
        bSlipCycleActive            := FALSE;
        bSlipUpperClampGrip         := TRUE;
        bSlipLowerClampGrip         := TRUE;
        wSystemStatusWord           := 16#9999;
        wAlarmWord.1                := TRUE;

        IF bSafetyEStopOk AND (rHydraulicSupplyPressure_bar >= 140.0) THEN
            wAlarmWord.1 := FALSE;
            iState := 0; (* Reset back to Initialization *)
        END_IF;

END_CASE;

(* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
   LAYER 5: ISA-18.2 SECONDARY THERMOMECHANICAL & HYDRAULIC ALARM MONITORING
   --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Contact Clamp Overtemperature Interlock (> 82.0 deg C) *)
tonThermalWarningDebounce(IN := (rClampTemperature_DegC > 82.0), PT := T#2S);
IF tonThermalWarningDebounce.Q THEN
    wAlarmWord.11 := TRUE; (* Bronze Shoe Thermal Overload Alarm *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.11 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Hydraulic Power Unit Pressure Low Alert (< 120.0 bar) *)
tonHydraulicPressureDebounce(IN := (rHydraulicSupplyPressure_bar < 120.0), PT := T#1S);
IF tonHydraulicPressureDebounce.Q THEN
    wAlarmWord.12 := TRUE; (* Hydraulic Supply Pressure Low Alert *)
    IF iState = 30 THEN
        iState := 10; (* Force hold position to prevent uncontrolled sinking *)
    END_IF;
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.12 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Sealed Furnace Freeboard Overpressure Hazard (> 180.0 Pa) *)
IF rFurnaceFreeboardPressure_Pa > 180.0 THEN
    wAlarmWord.13 := TRUE; (* Hood Gas Overpressure Alert *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord.13 := FALSE;
END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
